quote: The customer may audit Vendor's information security controls once per calendar year, on not less than 60 days' written notice.
policy_quote: We must retain the right to audit vendor's controls on at least 30 days' notice. Violation: no audit clause, or audit clause requiring more than 90 days' notice.
reason: An audit right exists, so this is not 'no audit clause'. Notice is 60 days, which is more than the 30-day requirement but not more than 90, so it is not the policy's listed violation. A human should decide whether to treat the 30-day shortfall as a gap to negotiate.
suggested_fix: Ask legal whether to negotiate the audit notice down to 30 days. Do not open this as a hard violation unless they say so.
